business_problem: Lorenz Snack World needed to modernize critical SAP systems so it could support growth, reduce downtime, scale for seasonal peaks, and keep up with new regulatory demands across its multinational snack business.
solution_summary: Lorenz Snack World migrated multiple SAP landscapes for HR and ERP from outsourced managed services to Google Cloud as the foundation for a broader business transformation. The core SAP estate now runs on SAP-certified Compute Engine virtual machines sized for S/4HANA and R3/HANA workloads, giving the company more flexibility to scale memory and capacity during production-planning and order-processing peaks. Around that core, Lorenz uses BigQuery for real-time analysis of production, logistics, and sales data, Google Workspace to support collaboration across Germany, Poland, and other teams, and Google Kubernetes Engine plus App Engine for non-SAP and custom applications. The company is also introducing Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform and Gemini for Workspace capabilities to improve internal productivity and future customer-facing recommendations. This architecture gives Lorenz a compliant, globally scalable cloud platform for both operational systems and newer AI initiatives.
